technique_name: Discuss the implications of using AI in healthcare
description: The use of AI in healthcare has the potential to transform the way we deliver care, diagnose diseases, and deliver treatments. AI can help increase the accuracy of diagnoses, identify patients at risk of diseases, and suggest treatments tailored to a patient's needs. AI can also help improve patient care by enabling better communication between healthcare providers, caregivers, and patients.
